Interface SubscriberIndex

public interface SubscriberIndex
Subscribes the @Subscribe methods a class declares, and those with a subscribing annotation: implemented by the code gaia-processor generates for that class, and found by EventBus.register(Object) with ServiceLoader.

Applications do not implement it. For a class com.example.Outer.Listener, the processor generates com.example.$Outer$Listener$$Subscribers, named as gaia-processing names a type generated for another, and registers it as a provider of this service. The event bus finds it by its listenerType().
